types.label: Landing blocked
types.description: A finished build can't land: CI failed, a conflict, or it needs you.

types.label: Kicked out of the merge queue
types.description: A PR failed its queue run and was taken out of the stack.

types.label: Merge gate: auto-fixing / rebuilding
types.description: A build that couldn't merge is being auto-fixed (yellow) or rebuilt on fresh main (blue), passed or merged (green), or failed 3 times (red), with the why. One notification per build, updated in place.
